profile.reading: Per LightEdge own site, the companys Des Moines Data Center #1 is at 1435 Northridge Circle, Altoona, IA 50009 (a second, Data Center #2, is at 1401 Northridge Circle). The page states LightEdge built the first purpose built commercial data center in Iowa, but does not publish square footage or power capacity figures for this location.

reading.body:
LightEdge Des Moines 1 publishes no power capacity or square footage figures on its spec page, only that it is located in Altoona, Iowa and claims to be the first purpose-built commercial data center in the state. Without published specifications, the campus cannot be assessed for its role in AI scaling.

Iowa has 52 mapped data center facilities but only 2 publish power capacity to this site, totaling 18 megawatts across the state. Des Moines 1 ranks third by published megawatts in Iowa, which means at least two other facilities in the state have disclosed their capacity while this one has not, making the ranking provisional and the campus's actual position unknown.

For a reader deciding whether this campus matters to AI infrastructure, the absence of published specifications makes assessment impossible. The operator's claim to historical precedent in Iowa does not substitute for current capacity data. Until LightEdge publishes power, cooling, or floor space figures, this facility cannot be placed in relation to the grid constraints that bind AI scaling.
